name: Unidentified fin-headed beaked species
description: A sentient species was distinguished by their beak-like mouths, with sunken eyes and a three-pronged head crest, the largest portion extending from the top, while two others jutted from the sides of their heads. By 22 BBY, a member of this species had been a Jedi of the Jedi Order, well known enough to have multiple busts of them displayed around the Jedi Archives.
